notes.title: Level editor bug fixes and adjustments
notes.content:
- Added: you can use up/w and down/s in the level editor to move the cursor faster
- Added: when you re-edit your level, you will be returned to the previous cursor position
- Added: when increasing the bar length and start buffer, hold shift to increase/decrease by 10
- Fixed bug that left your cursor in the middle of nowhere when adjusting bar length

notes.title: Melatonin Vinyl OST
notes.content:
Half Asleep is proud to announce that it has has partnered up with iam8bit to release a Melatonin 2xLP vinyl record which is now available to pre-order on the iam8bit store! This really is a dream come true so thank you for all your support since the game released.

This vinyl record includes the full Melatonin soundtrack PLUS 4 new bonus songs and some amazing art by snowlattes.

🎧 Pre-order it now at www.iam8bit.com/products/melatonin-2xlp

notes.title: Level Editor Update
notes.content:
After some robust testing on the Half Asleep Discord server, the level editor now includes the ability to edit each mashup in the game! You can switch between different dream worlds using the same tools already present in the game.

Just simply select the editor option when entering a mashup. More enhancements coming to the editor down the road including custom music. Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Melatonin is OUT NOW for PC/Mac!
notes.content:
Available on PC/Mac for $14.99 USD. Get it within the new few weeks for a limited time 10% off discount! Feel free to report bugs and leave feedback on Steam discussion forums or post in the Offical Discord Server. It helps a lot if you could also leave a review on Steam.

Melatonin is fully compatible with Steam Deck and even includes a display mode calibrated for the Steam Deck screen in the settings menu. It is also available on the Epic Games Store and will be coming soon to the Nintendo Switch. Have fun!

Also wanted to put together a list of some of the things I'll be working on for post-release content. If you're looking for more content from Melatonin, here are some of the free new content and features currently planned.

Editor

 Custom music support
 Editor support for mashup/remix levels

Levels

 Fun new twists on existing levels that I'll share more details on down the road

Accessibility

 Input tests for calibration
 Screen reader support
 Localizations

Technical

 16x10 support

General

 Quicker level and chapter select
